title: Transactional Lifecycle Audit OpenSees Extension: Native Material-API Reliability Evidence
description: Separately preregistered Tier-A native material-API extension for transactional lifecycle reliability assurance. The artifact records OpenSees 3.8.0 at commit 6e55293513192aa05c7e1205e66a5a1a1ed088c4, eight registered cases, 24 fresh processes, four controlled fault-localization rows, raw outputs, source, environment, licenses, and hashes. OS-F03 retains zero normalized replay drift while its lifecycle violation is detected. Controlled variants are not upstream OpenSees defects. The study is Tier A, not a solver-managed Tier-B trajectory, industrial validation, or a population reliability estimate. Parent v3.0.0 data and software releases remain immutable.
